@@ grey_elves
Less tall and lordly than the High Elves, the Grey Elves a nevertheless more noble than the Wood Elves. They are a settle people that feel a kinship for the sea (they are sometimes calle the “Sea Elves”).

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: Thin when compared to Men, the Grey Elves are nearly tall as the High Elves but are generally slighter of build. The are more muscular than the Wood Elf folk. Males average 19 pounds; females, 155 pounds. Coloring: Most have fair hair and pale blue or grey eyes. Like t High Elves, they have light skin. Endurance: They are capable of traveling 16-20 hours a day. S the general Elf description in Section A-3.0. Height: Males average 6'5"; females, 6'1". Lifespan: They are immortal and will only die due to violence if they weary of life and lose the will to live. Resistance: They cannot become sick or scarred and are virtual immune to disease. +15 DB and RR bonuses versus co attacks. Special Abilities: See the general Elf description in Section 3.0.

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: Grey Elf clothing is exceedingly we made, yet subtle and utilitarian. Greys and silvers are the chosen colors.

@@ intro
